title: On Dealing with the matter in silence
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：deal　|　正文 351 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 deal 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the craftsman ① dealt with the matter in silence with great care, and every apprentice in the workshop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the craftsman ② deals with the matter in silence on the same day without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ deal with the matter in silence at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ dealt with the matter in silence before — a line in the ledger for August 1978 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Dealing with the matter in silence with great care, the craftsman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the tool at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ deal the cards round the table on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Deal the cards round the table at once and never mention it again.

By 1991 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new apprentice from the next workshop ⑧ deals the cards round the table with great care every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ dealt with the matter in silence again when nobody else would.

⑩ To deal with the matter in silence, my mother said in 1996, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the workshop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the workshop forgets, somebody deals with the matter in silence on the same day again and somebody must deal with the matter in silence with great care all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 应对（一般过去式 dealt with the matter in silence：1984 年匠人头一回这样做，小心翼翼地）
B. v. 应对（一般现在 deals with the matter in silence：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 应对（不定式 to deal with the matter in silence：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 应对（过去完成时 had dealt with the matter in silence：1978 年八月的工料簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 应对（动名词 dealing with the matter in silence 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 发（牌）（deal the cards round the table：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去发（牌）在桌边发一圈牌）
G. v. 发（牌）（deal the cards round the table：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 应对（后段两处：新来的学徒照例 deals the cards round the table，而母亲又一次 dealt with the matter in silence）

answers.why: deal 意为“应对”，1984 年匠人小心翼翼地应对不动声色地应对那件事，那是工坊里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 dealt。
deal 意为“应对”，自那以后匠人当天就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 deals。
deal 意为“应对”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯应对不动声色地应对那件事”，此处为不定式 to deal with the matter in silence。
deal 意为“应对”，工料簿里 八月 那行字说明早在 1991 年之前就有人应对过，故用过去完成时 had dealt。
deal 意为“应对”，匠人说“应对不动声色地应对那件事这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 dealing with the matter in silence 作主语。
deal 意为“发（牌）”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去发（牌）在桌边发一圈牌”，should ever 之后用原形 deal the cards round the table。
deal 意为“发（牌）”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻发（牌）在桌边发一圈牌（deal the cards round the table at once），以后再也不要提起。
deal 意为“应对”，新来的学徒每个年头都照例发（牌）在桌边发一圈牌，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 deals。
deal 意为“应对”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次小心翼翼地应对不动声色地应对那件事，用一般过去式 dealt 叙述。
deal 意为“应对”，结尾那句是母亲 1996 年的话：要应对不动声色地应对那件事，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工坊记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 deal 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1984 the craftsman dealt with the matter in silence with great care, and nobody in the workshop forgot it.
Even now the craftsman deals with the matter in silence on the same day whenever the workshop asks.
Dealing with the matter in silence with great care, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever deal the cards round the table on the same day, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new apprentice from the next workshop deals the cards round the table with great care every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother dealt with the matter in silence again, and the workshop remembered that half.
